sources.title: United Nations Treaty Series No. 6497 — USSR–Iran frontier and financial settlement
sources.institution: United Nations Treaty Collection / United Nations Treaty Series
sources.coverage: 1954 Agreement concerning the settlement of frontier and financial questions, its Protocols and annexes, with official entry-into-force chronology
sources.notes: UN registration No. 6497 records signature at Tehran on 2 December 1954 and entry into force on 20 May 1955. The published Russian text preserves Article II's explicit references to the Russo-Persian boundary description signed at Beyramlu on 18 January 1829 and identifies the sectors replaced by the 1954 settlement.

sources.title: United Nations Treaty Series No. 6586 — Treaty concerning the régime of the Soviet-Iranian frontier
sources.institution: United Nations Treaty Collection / United Nations Treaty Series
sources.coverage: 1957 Soviet-Iranian frontier régime treaty, Protocol and annexes, including documentary identification of the April 1957 demarcation package
sources.notes: The treaty was signed at Moscow on 14 May 1957 and entered into force on 20 December 1962. Article 1 identifies the boundary as fixed by the demarcation and re-demarcation documents signed on 11 April 1957, including an album of maps/schemes, frontier-mark protocols and croquis, a coordinate catalogue of frontier marks, and a list of marks.
